title: AgentRunRecord
description: Privacy-filtered run record for one agent run (Sprint backlog OV-8). Carries receipts, capability references, policy proof ids, governance events and usage metrics only - never conversation content, prompts, responses, prompts-derived data, raw JWS bytes or credentials. Rule 3 of the architecture documents holds: `valid` and `unknown` remain distinct; no decision value is inferred from missing data. A run may describe real receipts or synthetic receipts (the committed demo index marks synthetic rows with synthetic=true); the record itself never claims a synthetic receipt is canonical evidence.

record_id.description: Stable identifier for this run record.

trace_ids.description: Traces belonging to the run. Correlation is a hint (architecture rule 4); the signed x_gate.trace_id, where present, is authoritative.

receipts.description: Gate receipts observed during the run, metadata fields only.

receipt_hash.description: Hash of the canonical receipt bytes, not the bytes themselves.

decision.description: Gate decision attached to this receipt. The string 'unknown' is a valid first-class value: it is never inferred into allow or deny.

chain_parent.description: receipt_hash of the parent receipt if this record participates in a receipt chain.

synthetic.description: True when the receipt row is a hand-built synthetic index case, never canonical evidence.

capability_refs.description: Tools the run exercised; each reference is a name, not an endpoint, grant or credential.

policy_proof_ids.description: Identifiers of policy/proof artefacts the receipts cite (e.g. policy_ref values, trust-policy versions). Ids only - never the policy text of a private policy.

usage_metrics.description: Counts only. No prompt/completion character or token text may be carried here.

privacy.description: Statement of what was filtered; the generator (tools/run_records/generate_fixtures.py) always sets this.
